name: approvals-platform
description: Human-in-the-loop approvals for AI agents: a versioned REST API with OpenAPI docs and a React dashboard for approving requests and working the exception queue.
author: Romulus Mirăuță (https://github.com/RomulusMirauta)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run e2e -w @approvals/e2e
scripts.screenshots: npm run build:contracts && npm run screenshots -w @approvals/e2e
